_comment: Template for YOLOX/YOLOv8 with distance estimation (PNG + radar)
_target: YOLOX or YOLOv8 with distance estimation (requires radar)

_key_flags.use_raw_events: false - Apply event representation to create image-like output
_key_flags.radar: REQUIRED for distance estimation - fused as additional channel
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person']). IDs Original COCO IDs preserved.
_key_flags.pad_size: [width_pad, height_pad] - Padding to add to native resolution (1280x720 for Prophesee)
_key_flags.fuse_dvs_radar_png: true - Create fused 3-channel images (2 DVS + 1 radar) as separate modality
_key_flags.fusion_dilation: Dilation kernel for radar in fused image (default: 5)

_comment: Radar source for fusion and distance extraction
